show.description: A newly divorced woman starts working as the PA to her strict boss — and soon, unexpected feelings begin to bloom. Between office drama, emotional twists, and a mysterious secret about her boss, things get delightfully complicated! Get ready for a breezy romantic ride filled with fun, love, and surprises — don’t miss it! 💕
